summary: CRT file-descriptor handle assignment. If the descriptor index a1 is in range and its slot (in the 36-byte-stride descriptor table) is empty (== -1), optionally binds the console standard handle matching a1 when dword_5E65B4 == 1, stores the supplied handle in the slot and returns 0; otherwise stores error 9 in the TLS error slot, clears the extended error slot and returns -1.

operations.description: Fail when a1 >= uNumber or the descriptor slot entry at dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) is not -1 (slot already occupied).

When dword_5E65B4 == 1, map descriptor index a1 to a console standard handle and assign hHandle to it: a1 0 -> SetStdHandle(0xFFFFFFF6), a1 1 -> SetStdHandle(0xFFFFFFF5), a1 2 -> SetStdHandle(0xFFFFFFF4).
Store hHandle into the descriptor slot entry at dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F).
Error path: write 9 through TLSOffsetGetter, write 0 through TLSOffsetGetter_afd8, and return -1.
